en: A colored illustration shows French soldiers in blue tunics with red trousers and kepis resting under a tree while a column of troops marches in the background. One soldier sits exhausted against the tree while others offer him a drink from a cup and a small bottle. Military packs and rifles lie on the ground. Below the scene is an advertisement image of a bottle labeled as Ricqlès mint alcohol and a French caption promoting it as a stimulant cordial.
